# hivenet_presets (Data Source)

Lists the hardware presets instances can run on, with their hourly price. The same hardware may be offered in several regions at different prices.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivenet_presets" "rtx4090_fr" {
  region           = "FR"
  free_text_search = "RTX 4090"
}

# Cheapest matching preset, using the discounted price when there is one.
locals {
  prices = {
    for p in data.hivenet_presets.rtx4090_fr.presets :
    p.id => coalesce(p.price_discounted, p.hourly_price)
  }
  cheapest_preset_id = [for id, price in local.prices : id if price == min(values(local.prices)...)][0]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `free_text_search` (String) Match against SKU name, GPU model and datacenter location, e.g. `RTX 4090`. The GPU model is not one of the returned attributes, so this is the way to filter on it.
- `region` (String) Only presets offered in this region, a name from `hivenet_regions`. An unknown value returns no presets rather than an error.
- `sku` (String) Only presets with this SKU name, e.g. `8x-RTX-4090`.

### Read-Only

- `presets` (Attributes List) Matching presets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--presets))

<a id="nestedatt--presets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `presets`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (Number) Virtual CPUs.
- `gpu` (String) GPU count as the API shows it, e.g. `8×`. The model is not included.
- `hourly_price` (Number) List price per hour, in credits.
- `id` (String) Preset ID, used when creating an instance.
- `location` (String) Datacenter within the region.
- `memory_gb` (Number) Memory, in GB.
- `price_discounted` (Number) Discounted price per hour, in credits. Null when no discount is active.
- `region` (String) Region the preset is offered in. Usually a region code; a datacenter with no region mapping reports its location name instead.
- `storage_gb` (Number) Storage, in GB.
